summary: The client called because their bill was higher than expected and they were concerned about a double charge on their account. The agent investigated the issue by identifying the duplicate charge and promptly refunded it. After confirming the resolution, the client expressed dissatisfaction with the lack of communication during the call and requested further explanation in future interactions.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly addressed the customer by name ("Hello?") and initiated the conversation with a friendly opening.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer’s frustration (“Let me take a look…”) and validated their concern about the bill increase.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a polite tone, chose words carefully (avoiding jargon), and kept a respectful pace. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the issue ("It’s been a while...") to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated the customer's name and account details.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked clarifying questions about the double charge (“Are you still there?”) to understand the root cause of the problem.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly stated the refund timeframe ("In 3 to 5 business days").

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent immediately resolved the issue by issuing a refund.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for the mistake and offered a solution.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to the customer’s concerns.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed the resolution ("Yes, I'll refund…”) before closing.

suggestions: What the client wanted: A refund for a double charge on their bill.
Suggestions / follow-ups:  Review account history to identify the source of the duplicate charge; proactively explain the process and timeline clearly in future interactions.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason
